'''Frank Edgar''' (born October 16, 1981) is an American wrestler and former professional [[mixed martial artist]] who competed in the [[Lightweight (MMA)|Lightweight]], [[Featherweight (MMA)|Featherweight]], and [[Bantamweight (MMA)|Bantamweight]] divisions of the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] (UFC), concluding his career as a Bantamweight.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ufc.com/rankings|title=Fighter Rankings|publisher=[[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]]|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150526175333/http://www.ufc.com/rankings|archive-date=May 26, 2015}}</ref> He is a former [[List of UFC champions#Lightweight Championship|Lightweight Champion]], and a multiple-time challenger for the [[List of UFC champions#Featherweight Championship|UFC Featherweight Championship]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=February 3, 2021|title=Stealing the spotlight, beating the odds: In
